parameters.help_en: The purpose or objective of the data import. This parameter is used to help reduce unnecessary communication
parameters.help_zh: 数据导入的业务背景，以减少沟通成本
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The stakeholders of the data import. All stakeholders can view the ticket details and assist in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than DMS administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details
parameters.name: related_user_list

fields.help_en: The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to import data. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter
fields.help_zh: 导入数据的附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html获取该参数的值
fields.name: attachment_name

fields.help_en: The reason for the data import
fields.name: classify

fields.help_en:
The type of the CSV file. Valid values:

true: The first row in the CSV file contains field names.
false: The first row in the CSV file contains data.

This parameter is required if you set the FileType parameter to CSV
fields.help_zh:
CSV格式的类型，取值如下：
true：CSV表格首行是字段名。
false：CSV表格首行是数据。

如果FileType为CSV，该参数必填
fields.name: csv_first_row_is_column_def

fields.help_en:
The ID of the database. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

To obtain the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
To obtain the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
fields.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
fields.name: db_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database.

If you set this parameter to true, the database that you specify must be a logical database
fields.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值如下：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库

如果取值为true，目标数据库必须为逻辑库
fields.name: logic

fields.help_en: The database to which you want to import data. You can specify only one database
fields.help_zh: 待导入的数据库列表，当前仅支持导入一个库
fields.name: db_item_list

fields.help_en:
Ticket execution mode. Valid values:  
COMMITOR: After approval, the submitter executes the ticket.  
AUTO: After approval, the system automatically executes the ticket.  
LAST_AUDITOR: After approval, the last approver executes the ticket.
fields.help_zh:
工单执行方式，取值如下：
COMMITOR : 审批通过后，提交者执行。
AUTO : 审批通过后，自动执行。
LAST_AUDITOR : 审批通过后，最后一个审批人执行
fields.name: exec_mode

fields.help_en:
The encoding algorithm to be used by the destination database. Valid values:

AUTO: automatic identification
UTF-8: UTF-8 encoding
GBK: GBK encoding
ISO-8859-1: ISO-8859-1 encoding
fields.help_zh:
文件编码，取值如下：
AUTO：自动识别
UTF-8：UTF8编码
GBK：GBK编码
ISO-8859-1：ISO-8859-1编码
fields.name: file_encoding

fields.help_en:
The format of the file for the data import. Valid values:

SQL: an SQL file
CSV: a CSV file
fields.help_zh:
文件类型，取值如下：
SQL：SQL文件。
CSV：CSV文件。
EXCEL：EXCEL文件。
JSON：JSON文件。仅部分数据库支持选择JSON，例如MongoDB
fields.name: file_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip an error that occurs. Valid values:

true: skips the error and continues to execute SQL statements.
false: stops executing SQL statements
fields.help_zh:
是否忽略报错，取值如下：
true：忽略，遇到错误会跳过当前失败SQL脚本，继续执行。
false：不忽略，遇到出错则中断后面的SQL脚本，不再执行
fields.name: ignore_error

fields.help_en:
The import mode. Valid values:

FAST_MODE: In the Execute step, the uploaded file is read and SQL statements are executed to import data to the specified destination database. Compared with the security mode, this mode can be used to import data in a less secure but more efficient manner.
SAFE_MODE: In the Precheck step, the uploaded file is parsed, and SQL statements or CSV file data is cached. In the Execute step, the cached SQL statements are read and executed to import data, or the cached CSV file data is read and imported to the specified destination database. This mode can be used to import data in a more secure but less efficient manner
fields.help_zh:
导入模式，取值如下：
FAST_MODE：极速模式，在执行阶段读取文件，将SQL语句直接执行到指定的目标库。该模式安全性相比安全模式要低，但是执行时效较高。
SAFE_MODE：安全模式，在预检查阶段会解析文件并将SQL或CSV数据缓存入库，执行时再从缓存库中读出来执行到指定的目标库。该模式安全性较好，但是执行时效相比极速模式要低
fields.name: import_mode

fields.help_en:
The mode in which the data in the CSV format is to be written to the destination table. Valid values:

INSERT: The database checks the primary key when data is written. If a duplicate primary key value exists, an error message is returned.
INSERT_IGNORE: If the imported data contains data records that are the same as those in the destination table, the new data records are ignored.
REPLACE_INTO: If the imported data contains a row that has the same value for the primary key or unique index as one row in the destination table, the database deletes the existing row and inserts the new row into the destination table.

This parameter is required if you set the FileType parameter to CSV
fields.help_zh:
插入类型，取值如下：

INSERT：插入数据时数据库会检查主键（PrimaryKey），如果出现重复会报错。
INSERT_IGNORE：如果表中已经存在相同的记录，则忽略当前新数据。
REPLACE_INTO：如果表中已经有某行数据（根据主键或者唯一索引判断），则先删除此行数据，然后插入新的数据。

如果FileType为CSV，该参数必填
fields.name: insert_type

fields.help_en:
The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to roll back the data import. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter.

This parameter is required if you set the RollbackSqlType parameter to ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html获取该参数的值。

如果RollbackSqlType为ATTACHMENT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_attachment_name

fields.help_en:
The SQL statements used to roll back the data import.

This parameter is required if you set the RollbackSqlType parameter to TEXT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL语句。
如果RollbackSqlType为TEXT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_sql

fields.help_en:
The format of the SQL statements used to roll back the data import. Valid values:

TEXT: text
ATTACHMENT: attachment
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL的提交方式，取值如下：
TEXT：文本
ATTACHMENT：附件
fields.name: rollback_sql_type

fields.help_en:
The destination table to which you want to import the data in the CSV format.

This parameter is required if you set the FileType parameter to CSV
fields.help_zh:
选择CSV格式文件导入数据的目标表。
如果FileType为CSV，该参数必填
fields.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The key of the attachment that provides more instructions for the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter
parameters.help_zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: attachment_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user who actually invokes the API.
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
